tool_input.code:
import openpyxl, os
p=os.environ['OUT_XLSX']
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(p)
ws=wb['Sheet1']
for r in range(2,7):
    ws.cell(row=r,column=2).value=f'=IFERROR(VLOOKUP(A{r},Sheet2!A:B,2,0),"")'
wb.save(p)
print('done')
